verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Claude can remember context from chats and carry it into new conversations and Cowork tasks [claude-docs-69]. They also document searching previous conversations to reference relevant information in new chats [claude-docs-2], and reviewing, editing and toggling saved memory [claude-docs-45]. Memory across conversations is also advertised on the homepage [claude-docs-21], and memory import from other providers is supported [claude-docs-1]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that memory recall works reliably in practice.
